description: Motivated Seller! Need concessions? Just ask! Thoughtfully refreshed, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, space, and value. Recent improvements include new carpet throughout the above ground levels, fresh interior and exterior paint, new kitchen countertops and sink, newer appliances, updated light fixtures, ceiling fans, and outlets, a refreshed wood-burning fireplace, and a recently certified furnace for added peace of mind. This beautiful home offers a warm, inviting layout perfect for daily living and entertaining. The bright front living room with large windows flows seamlessly into the spacious formal dining area. The kitchen features abundant cabinet space, a pantry, and an eat-in dining area. Just off the kitchen, the cozy family room showcases the wood-burning fireplace and direct access to the backyard patio. The main level also includes a conveniently located laundry room with washer and dryer included, along with a generously sized half bath for guests. Upstairs, you'll find 4 bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with a walk-in closet and private ¾ en-suite bath featuring a new vanity. The upper level also includes a beautifully remodeled full bathroom serving the secondary bedrooms. The partially finished basement expands the living space with a large recreation area, non-conforming bedroom, full bathroom, and generous storage area. Ready for your personal touches, the basement presents an excellent opportunity for future updates and equity. Step outside to enjoy the large concrete patio, play area, storage shed perfect for gardening supplies, and established landscaping with roses, peonies, and more. The property also offers secure fenced RV parking complete with a 30-amp plug. A charming front patio offers a great place to relax. No HOA. Ideally located near Standley Lake, trails, parks, shopping, and everyday amenities, this home offers the perfect combination of thoughtful improvements, flexible living space, and future potential.
